The Inner Bliss approach

Four steps, never forced

1

Gentle sharing

Your story opens only at the pace your body, mind, heart and energy allow. Nothing is pushed. Nothing is forced. Some questions are asked to find the real root of the challenge.

2

Embodied emotional release

Unexpressed emotional energy is tapped by mapping the physical sensations of an emotion. Breath, touch-based grounding, micro-movements and somatic work help the body unwind old trauma loops.

3

Nervous system regulation

A space of deep trust, openness, non-judgement and safety resets the aggravated nervous system to its natural rhythm.

4

Real life integration

Once the energy is released and the root cause is understood, the shifts are brought into daily life so they are lasting and real.

Group retreats

Embodied emotional healing retreats

Deep emotional containers where your body can open, release, reset and reconnect, supported by nature, community, movement, ritual and somatic healing.

Why these retreats are transformative

Six pillars of the journey

1

Deep inner grounding

Before releasing any stuck energy, we ground our awareness of the emotions, so we know which emotions we need to work with.

2

Awareness of body sensations

The body is the storehouse of emotions and also the medium through which stuck emotional energy is released.

3

Ritual and ceremony

Rituals and ceremonies create potent portals of life force energy to release the heaviness of body, mind and heart.

4

Sharing and integration circles

Sharing acts as a map of where we are and where we want to travel, a compass for the group’s healing journey.

5

Somatic trauma-release practices

Let go of accumulated tension, activate the healing energy of the heart, and arrive in grounding, ease and inner bliss.

6

Life integration

Learn less, apply more. Applying and integrating the practices in daily life is the crucial take-away.

Retreat description

Our primal life force

We harness our Primal Life Force Energy, which is coated with pollutants such as fear, judgement, substances, processed foods, unprocessed emotions and toxic connections. We rid it of these and learn to keep it clean and fluid.

Once it is back in its primal nature, we transform it into a flow of inner creativity, healing and bliss. Support from others makes the journey playful, easier and quicker.

Personal retreats

Tailor-made, slow-paced, deeply yours

Ideally long in duration. The daily schedule, curriculum, focus, pace and practices are designed around the current state of being of the participant.

The idea behind them

What a personal retreat holds

1

Look at the real-life issues, circumstances and patterns in different aspects of your life.

2

Understand the root cause of the challenges, and catch the start point of the loop that repeats the pattern.

3

Learn practices to ground your life force energy and direct it towards resolving the root cause.

4

Understand the wisdom of real life in relation to the actual challenges and patterns in your life.

5

Learn to apply and integrate the wisdom and practices in daily life situations.

6

Create a daily practice routine.

7

Learn SOS tools, hacks and practices for life situations as they arise.

These practices are not quick fixes. Life integration takes time, consistent focus, deep grounding and nervous system regulation. During the retreat, we train for these skills.

For more details, schedule a discovery call. Share what is present in your life, body, mind and heart that needs to be resolved, and we will arrive at a plan.

Five stages

How a session unfolds

1

Trust and safety

Creating a space of deep trust felt in the body and energy of the receiver is the groundwork before a session begins.

2

Sharing

You share about the situation(s) you want to resolve.

3

Root cause

Together we find the root cause of the situation to be resolved.

4

Wisdom and perspective

5

Practices and shifts

Practices, lifestyle and mindset shifts to help resolve the situation.

About Samarth

Founder and lead facilitator of Inner Bliss

Samarth is the founder and lead facilitator of Inner Bliss Retreats, a platform focused on meditation, self-awareness and personal well-being. With a deep interest in human psychology, emotional balance and conscious living, he designs and facilitates experiential workshops, meditation programs and retreats that help people manage stress, improve clarity and develop deeper self-awareness.

His approach combines meditation practices, breath awareness, body movement, reflective exercises and group processes that support both personal insight and practical life integration.

His work is rooted in the belief that inner well-being directly influences creativity, relationships and decision-making in everyday life. Participants are encouraged to explore stillness, emotional awareness and conscious living in a grounded and accessible way.

Samarth is also a writer and poet who explores themes of human experience, self-discovery and inner transformation.

The love energy of the heart is the ultimate healer.

I am here to support people on the path to their heart.
